name: Tel-Jilad
description: The largest tree in the Tangle on Mirrodin, sacred home of the Mirrodin trolls.

description_citations.text: "Troll". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa has a vision while hunting a vorrac with Kane and distrusts the trolls' memory-erasing ceremony.
timeline.quote: She believes her visions are repressed memories that are key to the elves' past

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Glissa's vision". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Levelers kill Glissa's parents and sister; green flame erupts from Glissa and she is dragged away.
timeline.quote: she finds they have killed her parents and sister.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Glissa's vision". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chunth reveals the elves' racial memory and the vedalken, then is blasted dead by a rogue troll who tells Glissa the world is hollow.
timeline.quote: A dying Chunth tells Glissa that the world is hollow before passing on.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Returning home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The cloaked vedalken melts Kane's metal with a bolt, killing him; Glissa maims the wizard and destroys his aerophin.
timeline.quote: hits Kane with a magic bolt from his staff that melts every piece of metal on his body, killing him in agony.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Returning home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Most Tel-Jilad trolls die out under Memnarch, and the Vanishing returns the rest home save Thrun, the Last Troll.
timeline.quote: Most of the Tel-Jilad trolls died out during Memnarch 's rule

citation.text: "Troll", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
